note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1955: contests in Ballymoyer and Mullaghbane, polled 2 June 1955; no party labels printed for the unopposed members. Polled 2 June 1955. Murphy was the outgoing member; 87.01 per cent poll, no spoilt votes. The Newry Telegraph prints 308 on the register for both divisions.
